use System.Math
use Raster.IMAGE

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

line(from_x: int, from_y: int, to_x: int, to_y: int) is
    let across = Math.abs(to_x - from_x)
    let up = Math.abs(to_y - from_y)

    let step_x = if from_x < to_x then 1 else -1 fi
    let step_y = if from_y < to_y then 1 else -1 fi

    let x mut = from_x
    let y mut = from_y
    let error mut = across - up

    do
        image.set_pixel(x, y, 0ub, 0ub, 160ub)

        if x == to_x /\ y == to_y then
            break
        fi

        let doubled = error * 2

        if doubled > -up then
            error = error - up
            x = x + step_x
        fi

        if doubled < across then
            error = error + across
            y = y + step_y
        fi
    od
si

for spoke in 0..24 do
    let angle = 2.0D * Math.pi * cast double(spoke) / 24.0D

    line(
        200, 200,
        200 + cast int(180.0D * Math.cos(angle)),
        200 + cast int(180.0D * Math.sin(angle))
